scenes.location: Office Conference Room and Break Room
scenes.description: Iris Taylor is attending a team meeting in the conference room. Her body is still recovering from a recent burn injury, and she is visibly uncomfortable. Her colleague Luna notices and suggests she take some time off. Later, Iris meets with her partner David in the break room and discusses her situation further.

scenes.plot: During a team meeting, Iris's colleague Luna notices her discomfort and offers support in taking leave. Later, Iris confides in her partner David, who reassures her and encourages her to prioritize her health. Iris is caught between her desire to fulfill her work responsibilities and the need for self-care.
scenes.social_purpose: To explore the tension between work responsibilities and personal health, and to highlight the importance of support and understanding in maintaining balance.

chunk.text: Iris Taylor sat at the conference table, her hand resting on her forehead as she tried to focus on the meeting. The burn on her arm throbbed, and the itching was almost unbearable. Luna, seated across from her, watched with concern. 'Hey Iris, I've noticed you're not yourself today. Are you okay? Do you need help taking some time off if you're feeling overwhelmed?' she asked. Iris hesitated, her determination warring with her fragile state. 'I appreciate the concern, Luna, but I'm trying to manage. I don't want to fall behind or burden anyone else.' Later, in the break room, she met with her partner David. 'I'm so tired, David. I just want to take care of myself, but I don't want to let my team down. It's hard to find balance right now.' David took her hand gently. 'Your health is more important than anything else, Iris. You don't have to do everything alone. Taking a step back is a sign of strength, not weakness.'
